name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
body: I have not held a Product Manager title, and for a Staff-level role I want to say that upfront rather than let it surface later. What I have done for 15 years is the actual mechanics of the job: take an ambiguous business problem, define what needs to be true, and ship a working system, most recently AI agent architectures that I design, build, and iterate on myself.

At Wix, I helped take a brand-new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including hiring and training the team that ran it. A manager's written recommendation credits me as the first to pitch the ideas that made it work. At Solenzo, I architect AI-driven agent systems for clients end to end. I translate a business owner's vague idea into structured prompts and agent logic, build the system, then run evaluation loops and rubric-based grading to keep the output on standard, the same build-measure-iterate loop this role is asking for. At Birdeye, I worked directly with Product and Engineering to turn structured customer feedback into roadmap input.

I know a Staff PM search usually screens for people who have carried the title before. I'm applying anyway because the underlying work, translating ambiguity into a shipped, measurable system, is what I've actually been doing, just without that label on my badge. If that's a gap you're willing to look past, I'd welcome the conversation.
